title_ar: الجواب الصحيح لمن بدل دين المسيح
title_es_or_en: al-Jawab al-Sahih li-man baddala din al-Masih (Ibn Taymiyya; refutation of Christians, incl. Paul of Sidon/Antioch letter quoted at length)
edition_note: al-Jawab al-Sahih li-man baddala din al-Masih, 2nd ed. (1419/1999), Dar al-'Asima (Saudi Arabia), eds. 'Ali ibn Hasan, 'Abd al-'Aziz ibn Ibrahim, Hamdan ibn Muhammad (per OpenITI #META# header). Page/volume from OpenITI PageV markers in Shamela_0000170 text; verify against the printed edition before quoting.
notes: Passages by Ibn Taymiyya in his own voice (replies) and quoted Christian text marked "قالوا" / "وأما قولهم..." (e.g., vol 3 pp. 414-425, vol 3 p. 30, vol 2 p. 79-92). Method stated in vol 1 p. 100: quotes the Christian letter verbatim, chapter by chapter, then replies.

edition_note: Majmu' al-Fatawa, ed. 'Abd al-Rahman ibn Muhammad ibn Qasim, Majma' al-Malik Fahd (1416/1995) (per OpenITI header, Shamela_0007289). Page markers from the OpenITI text; verify printed page.
notes: Used for the qira'at fatwa duplicate (vol 13 pp. 388-403; same text as the Risala) and for vol 20 p. 261 and vol 22 p. 352 (excluded, see excluded.json). Not used for Christian passages.

title_es_or_en: Risala fi 'ilm al-qira'at (fatwa on the qira'at)
edition_note: Risala fi 'ilm al-qira'at (fatwa), ed. Muhammad 'Ali Sultani, Majallat al-Buhuth al-Islamiyya no. 13 (1405 AH) per OpenITI header (Shamela-based, ShamAY0034398). The 'PageV13Pxxx' markers are read here as pages of that issue (inferred from the header; not confirmed on scans). The same fatwa text (with near-identical wording) is in Majmu' al-Fatawa vol. 13 (OpenITI page markers 13:388-403).
notes: Own answer to questions on the seven ahruf, the seven readings, shadhdh readings, and prayer. Editor's CHECK tags and folio marks (1/ب) appear in the text.

edition_note: al-Nubuwwat, ed. 'Abd al-'Aziz ibn Salih al-Tuwayyan, Adwa' al-Salaf, 1st ed. 1420/2000 (per OpenITI header, Shamela_0011817; header inspected).
